verdict.rationale: Fenwick documents AI tools that analyze uploaded material and return insights: a brief-analysis interface that suggests relevant uncited cases, and contract-review tooling that extracts key provisions and writes summaries. These tools are described as lawyer-facing, though. The client-facing trademark extranet offers only search, reporting and dashboards, with no AI. missing for 10: evidence that clients themselves get AI insights on their own data inside a client-facing product, AI features in the extranet or dashboards, any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Lawyers simply upload a legal brief into the interface, which then quickly identifies highly relevant cases that are not cited in the brief.
can automate the extraction and analysis of key contract provisions and create summaries in seconds
